claims.sectionKey: Distribución contemporánea del más-que-perfeito en textos escritos
claims.summary: Móia (2024) reports widespread contemporary use of the simple and compound pluperfect forms (with ter and haver) in written European and Brazilian Portuguese, in a relatively balanced distribution across the registers considered: newspaper writing, modern literary texts, and modern literary translations. Thus, “literary” is one documented register, not an exclusive label.
